purpose: Reusable official membership certificate template for all approved RLS Association members.
source: User-supplied reference image from 2026-11-10. Preserve its layout, ornaments, colors, Russian landmarks, flag, upper-left journal emblem, and lower-center seal placement.

fixed_visuals.border: ornate double navy-and-gold academic frame with decorative corners
fixed_visuals.upper_left: journal seal-derived emblem adapted for association certificate
fixed_visuals.left: Saint Basil's Cathedral illustration and laurel
fixed_visuals.lower_center: fixed journal seal extracted from the supplied Word document

data_rules.member_number_format: 6 digits, Persian numerals on the Persian certificate
data_rules.certificate_code_format: RLS- plus the six-digit member number
data_rules.numbers: Render Persian numerals in Persian copy; preserve certificate code in left-to-right Latin characters.

print_notes: Use actual member data only; never invent dates or serial numbers.
Do not alter the master border, palette, layout, logo, or seal position for individual members.
Keep the QR code readable with a white quiet zone.
Use A4 landscape and print-color-adjust: exact.
